title: 2-Aminoethanaminium 2-(ethoxycarbonyl)-4,6-dinitrophenolate as a greener route in reducing sugar quantification
author: Zohri, Abdelazim, et al.

steps.title: Prepare DNS reagent solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 1 g 3,5-dinitrosalicylic acid in 100 ml of 1 % (w/v) NaOH, then add 0.2 g phenol and 0.05 g sodium bisulfite; mix thoroughly and store at room temperature.

steps.title: Synthesize and prepare AED reagent
steps.instruction: React ethyl 3,5-dinitrosalicylate (prepared from ethyl salicylate, sulfuric acid and nitric acid) with ethylenediamine in hot ethanol for 5 min, collect the yellow precipitate, recrystallize from water to obtain AED; dissolve 1 g AED in 100 ml of 1 % NaOH and add 0.05 g sodium bisulfite; mix well.

steps.title: Assay glucose with DNS method
steps.instruction: Mix 3 ml glucose solution (0.1–0.5 mg ml⁻¹) with 3 ml DNS reagent, heat the mixture at 90 °C for 15 min, add 1 ml of 40 % sodium potassium tartrate, cool to room temperature, then measure absorbance at 540 nm.

steps.title: Assay glucose with AED method
steps.instruction: Mix 3 ml glucose solution (0.1–0.5 mg ml⁻¹) with 3 ml AED reagent, heat at 90 °C for 15 min, cool to room temperature, and record absorbance at 545 nm.
